note: Seed exercise catalog with hand-authored sub-muscle tags. This is the layer no free exercise API provides, and the reason the app can answer 'does this workout actually hit my rear delts?'. Upstream sources (wger, free-exercise-db) can be merged in later via source/source_id without disturbing these tags. 'p' = primary movers, 's' = secondary/assisting.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie flat, lower the bar to mid chest with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.description: Bench set to 30 degrees. Lower to the upper chest just below the collarbone.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Press
exercises.description: Decline bench, bar lowered to the lower chest. Shorter range than flat pressing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Flat bench with dumbbells. Allows a deeper stretch than a barbell.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: 30 degree incline. One of the most reliable upper-chest builders.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Decline bench with dumbbells, pressing slightly toward the feet.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.description: Seated press with a fixed path. Good for training close to failure safely.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.description: Inclined fixed-path press targeting the clavicular chest.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: Body in a straight line, hands slightly wider than shoulders, chest to the floor.

exercises.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
exercises.description: Feet on a bench shifts the emphasis to the upper chest and front delts.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.description: Regression of the push-up with the knees on the floor.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.description: Lean the torso forward on parallel bars to bias the lower chest.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.description: Pulleys at chest height, arms sweeping together with a slight elbow bend.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
exercises.description: Pulleys set low, hands finishing at eye level. Upper chest isolation.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
exercises.description: Pulleys set high, hands finishing near the hips.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Flat bench, wide arc with soft elbows. Control the stretch.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Fly performed on a 30 degree incline.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.description: Seated machine fly with a fixed arc.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.description: Lying across or along a bench, arc a dumbbell back over the head.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: Overhand grip, pull the chest toward the bar and control the descent.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.description: Underhand grip. Noticeably more biceps than a pull-up.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.description: Palms facing each other. Usually the most shoulder-friendly variation.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Pull the bar to the upper chest, driving the elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pulldown
exercises.description: Narrow neutral handle, longer range of motion at the bottom.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.description: Arms nearly locked, sweep the bar from overhead to the thighs.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.description: Hinged torso around 45 degrees, row the bar to the lower ribcage.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.description: Torso parallel to the floor, bar resets on the ground between reps.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: One hand braced on a bench, row the dumbbell to the hip.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.description: Chest against a pad removes the lower back from the equation.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Pull to the navel with a tall chest, avoid rocking the torso.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.description: Landmine or T-bar station, rowed with a neutral grip.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: Body under a fixed bar, heels on the floor, pull the chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Rope at face height, pull toward the forehead with the elbows high.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.description: Elevate the shoulders straight up. No rolling.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.description: Shrug with dumbbells at the sides for a longer range.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.description: Hinge and drive the floor away, keeping the bar against the legs.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.description: Partial deadlift from around knee height.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.description: Hyperextension bench, extend the spine and hips to a neutral finish.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.description: Bar on the back, hinge forward with soft knees.

exercises.name: Prone Y-Raise
exercises.description: Face down on an incline, raise the arms into a Y. The lower-trap fix most people are missing.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.description: Standing press from the collarbone to lockout, ribs down.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Back supported, press dumbbells overhead without clanging them together.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Rotate from palms-in to palms-forward as you press.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Fixed-path overhead press.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.description: Leg drive assists the press, allowing heavier loads than a strict press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Raise to shoulder height leading with the elbows, no swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Constant tension through the whole range, unlike dumbbells.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Seated fixed-path abduction.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.description: Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows. Use a wider grip if it pinches.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.description: Raise to eye level with a controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.description: Machine fly run backwards. The easiest way to actually load the rear delts.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Reverse Fly
exercises.description: Hinged torso, sweep the dumbbells out and slightly back.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description: Cross-body cable fly at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.description: Arms straight, pull a band apart across the chest. Ideal warm-up filler.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.description: Hips high, lower the crown of the head toward the floor.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.description: Press a landmine bar up and forward. Kind to cranky shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Elbows pinned at the sides, curl without swinging the torso.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.description: Angled bar reduces wrist strain versus a straight bar.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Curl with supination, one arm or both.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Arms hanging behind the body puts the long head under stretch.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.description: Upper arms on the pad, biased to the short head in the shortened position.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description: Seated, elbow braced against the inner thigh.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Neutral grip throughout. Builds arm thickness rather than peak.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description: Low pulley curl with constant tension.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.description: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.description: Overhand grip curl. The most direct brachialis work there is.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Shoulder-width grip, elbows tucked. The heaviest triceps builder.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.description: Upright torso on parallel bars keeps the load on the triceps.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Extension
exercises.description: Arms overhead puts the long head under stretch — the head pushdowns miss.

exercises.name: Skullcrusher
exercises.description: Lying extension, lowering the bar to the forehead or just behind it.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Bar)
exercises.description: Elbows at the sides, extend to lockout.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
exercises.description: Rope allows the hands to separate at lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Extension
exercises.description: Single dumbbell held overhead with both hands.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.description: Hands on a bench behind you, feet on the floor or a second bench.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.description: Hands together under the chest.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.description: Forearms on the thighs, flex the wrists through a full range.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
exercises.description: Palms down version. Often neglected and worth training for elbow health.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.description: Carry heavy weights for distance or time with a tall posture.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.description: Hang from a bar for time. Grip work plus a shoulder decompression.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: Bar on the upper back, squat to at least parallel with the knees tracking the toes.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: Bar racked on the front delts. More upright, more quad.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: Machine squat with the back supported.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Press the sled away without letting the lower back round at the bottom.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Rear foot elevated. Brutal, and one of the best single-leg builders.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description: Step forward into a lunge and continue walking.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Dumbbell held at the chest. The best squat to learn the pattern with.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description: Seated knee extension. The only common way to isolate the quads.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.description: Knees travel forward while the hips stay extended.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.description: Step onto a box driving through the front heel.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.description: Fixed bar path allows a more forward foot position and more quad bias.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hinge with soft knees, bar tracking the thighs, stop when the stretch runs out.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Same hinge with dumbbells, easier to learn.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.description: Face-down knee flexion.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.description: Hip flexed position lengthens the hamstrings — slightly better growth stimulus than lying.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.description: Ankles anchored, lower the torso under control. Heavily eccentric.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description: Shoulders on a bench, drive the hips to full extension and squeeze.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Floor version of the hip thrust.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.description: Rope between the legs from a low pulley, hinge and drive the hips forward.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description: Wide stance, hands inside the knees, more upright than conventional.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.description: Single-leg hip extension against a low pulley.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.description: Seated, press the knees apart. Direct glute medius work.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.description: Band above the knees, step sideways in a half squat.

exercises.name: Adductor Machine
exercises.description: Seated, squeeze the knees together.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.description: Side plank with the top leg on a bench. Serious adductor work.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: Knees straight, full stretch at the bottom and a pause at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description: Bent knees take the gastroc out, leaving the soleus. Most people skip this and wonder why their calves stall.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.description: Toes on the edge of the sled, press through the forefoot.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.description: Hinged-over calf raise for a deeper stretch.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Forearms down, ribs pulled toward the hips, hold for time.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang and raise straight legs without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Kneeling, crunch the ribs toward the pelvis against a high pulley. Loadable, so it progresses.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Short-range spinal flexion.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.description: Full range flexion to a seated position.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Seated rotation with the feet off the floor.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight line on one forearm.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description: Roll out as far as you can hold a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.description: Resist rotation while pressing a cable straight out from the chest.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: On your back, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchopper
exercises.description: Diagonal chop from high to low across the body.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.description: Curl the pelvis toward the ribs, lifting the hips off the floor.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.description: Body held rigid, pivoting at the shoulders. Very advanced.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: Face down, lift the arms and legs simultaneously.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.description: GHD bench, combining knee flexion and hip extension.
